items.zh: 麻省理工学院和博德研究所的研究人员打破了超分辨率显微镜的衍射障碍

items.title: Physicists Solve a Big Quantum Mystery. Now, Old Results Don’t Add Up.
items.summary: New calculations seem to have put a 25-year-old particle physics puzzle to rest. But they’ve also created a clash with other experimental results. The post Physicists Solve a Big Quantum Mystery. Now, Old Results Don’t Add Up. first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 物理学家解决了一个巨大的量子之谜。现在，旧的结果不再成立。

items.title: A New Way That a Cow’s Inner World Shapes Earth’s Atmosphere
items.summary: An organelle discovered inside a microbe inside a cow’s gut helps explain how livestock burps contribute to warming our planet. The post A New Way That a Cow’s Inner World Shapes Earth’s Atmosphere first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 牛的内心世界塑造地球大气的新方式

items.title: MIT engineers design recyclable elastic yarn
items.summary: Melt it, spin it, use it again. This new recyclable yarn is as strong and stretchy as spandex-based yarns.
